description:
This process begins when a potential customer inquires about a product or service.
Sales staff or customer support collects relevant information and addresses any concerns or questions.
If the customer is interested, they are guided through selecting the appropriate product or service.
Next, the sales representative provides a quote, and after approval from the customer, the process moves to order placement.
The order is then recorded in the system, and the customer receives confirmation of their order.
The process ends when the order is successfully placed and confirmed.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_ProductOrder"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/product-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Customer approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ProductOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Sales" name="Product or service order process" processRef="Process_Sales"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Potential customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Customer approval" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Sales" name="Product or service order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inquiry" name="Customer inquires">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_Address</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_Address</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Address_Interest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Interest" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_Interest_No">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Address_Interest</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interest_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Interest_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide product or service selection">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interest_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Guide_Quote</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote" messageRef="Message_Quote">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Guide_Quote</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Quote_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApproval" name="Receive customer approval" messageRef="Message_Approval">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Quote_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_PlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_PlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Place_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Place_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_Confirmation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_Confirmation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Confirmation_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderConfirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Confirmation_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoContinuation" name="No continuation described">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Interest_No</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="Start_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Address" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Address_Interest" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_Interest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interest_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerInterested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interest_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interest" targetRef="End_NoContinuation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guide_Quote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quote_Approval" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Place_Record" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_End" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
